test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option no correction required if the sentence is correct as given.

His temperament (disposed him to) argue readily with people.
solution:
The correct answer is** "No correction required​".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct preposition to use after "disposed" in this context is "to", not "of" or "of
